svg.title: Model fit decides which parallelism to test first: replicas, tensor split, pipeline split, or expert split.
svg.desc: Tensor parallelism splits individual weight matrices across GPUs and communicates after each layer, favoring fast intra-node links. Pipeline parallelism splits layers sequentially across GPUs and can span nodes, but bubbles reduce utilization. Data parallelism replicates the full model so each replica serves independent requests with no cross-replica communication. Expert parallelism distributes mixture-of-experts across GPUs using all-to-all communication for token routing.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Four ways to split an LLM across GPUs

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Start with data parallelism when the model fits on one GPU; add tensor, pipeline, or expert splits as it stops fitting.

svg.text: Starting heuristic: one GPU → DP. One node → TP, then replicate. Spans nodes → TP + PP.

svg.text: MoE → add EP only if placement requires it. Validate memory, communication, and latency.
